page.overview:
Who is Shiba?

Shiba is a cocky ex-skateboard World Champion. He despises evil since he was involved in a terrorist attack. Nowadays he collaborates with Delta Red and uses a hoverboard invented by George Ginzu. He's followed by a supporting robot named , which can attack with flames spewed from its mouth. He also has a mysterious relationship with Nash.
